title: Judge Blocks F.C.C. From Targeting Disney’s Local ABC Licenses
summary: A preliminary injunction halted an early regulatory review of the network’s operations in eight cities, including New York, Los Angeles and Chicago.
caption: ABC has borne the brunt of an attempt by the Federal Communications Commission to pressure the nation’s original broadcast networks over what it sees as liberal, anti-Trump bias.

title: Trump Rejoiced in the Market’s Nvidia Surge. It Didn’t Last Long.
summary: The retreat of the stock market in recent days shows how President Trump’s push to reinstall the company’s chief executive has collided with the realities of his other policies.
caption: President Trump has made it clear that he does not subscribe to the theory that if a president is responsible for market surges, he must also be responsible for declines.

title: In China, the ‘Female Gaze’ Is Driving a New Entertainment Boom
summary: From male dancers to handsome hiking companions, a thriving entertainment industry is catering to female fantasies and testing the limits of Beijing’s tolerance.
authors: Murphy Zhao, Alexandra Stevenson and Gilles Sabrié

title: The New Itty-Bitty Fiat Is a Nifty Fit for the City
summary: The Topolino is so small it’s street-legal only on roads with low speed limits. The electric motor is tiny, and the range is limited. But there’s still lots to like.
authors: Jamie Lincoln Kitman and Amir Hamja

title: Trump Tried to Cripple Huawei. Now It Is Central to China’s A.I. Push.
summary: As China’s access to Nvidia’s advanced chips shrinks, Huawei is becoming increasingly indispensable to Beijing despite a wide technological gap with its American rival.
caption: China’s top leader, Xi Jinping, and Huawei’s founder, Ren Zhengfei, in London in 2015.

title: ‘Avengers’ and ‘Dune’ Have Hollywood Dreaming of a December Windfall
summary: “Avengers: Doomsday” and “Dune: Part Three” are expected to open to at least $350 million in ticket sales. Some forecasts approach $500 million.

title: Nvidia Halts Sales to Southeast Asia as U.S. Tightens China Restrictions
summary: The shipping halt, which hit four countries, follows a new U.S. rule that would require licenses for companies in the countries to buy advanced A.I. chips.

title: Photos: Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade History and Wacky Moments
summary: It isn’t always easy to keep New York City’s Thanksgiving parade on track. Here’s a look back at notable moments and mishaps.
caption: A sudden gust of wind blew Betty Boop into the trees along Central Park West during the 1991 parade.

title: Flights at Miami Airport Are Disrupted After FedEx Jet Overshoots Runway
summary: The plane overran a runway after landing at Miami International Airport on Wednesday, and stopped near a fence. FedEx said there were no injuries.
caption: A FedEx cargo plane overran a runway while landing at Miami International Airport on Wednesday.
